intro_same: Practice: the same Kaveri rehearsal, with fewer hints and harder questions. The log is in IST and the clocks run in UTC, so convert every time before you answer.

ask: By what IST time (HH:MM) must CERT-In be told?
How many minutes after noticing did the analyst call the CISO?
At what UTC time (HH:MM) did the scraping stop?
What was the last customer ID the scraper received?
Which program did the scraper's user agent name? (the name before the slash)
How many affected customers live in Germany?
What percentage of the affected customers live in India, to the nearest whole number?
On which date is the detailed report to the Data Protection Board due? (YYYY-MM-DD)
How many affected customers live outside India?
